body:
**CLOSE-R000D — qualified and delivered**

Issue #13 remains OPEN at certificate publication. This certificate records independently accepted original R000D qualification and actual delivery. Intentional completed closure follows independent readback of this actual comment and its references; it is not an advance claim that the issue is already closed.

PR #63 was merged by normal merge commit `ed5e7afbd2fcf7a59050817e2a561bcdbfa9043d` with ordered parents `06772824a159cd2bc42a1d9f79a3fb22fa46e49d` and `94b5ddf5d61feb4c166050bed1460c6940eb20ad`. The merged tree `d08731d4219c86e0fcebbc94804bddacf7768f4d` equals the reviewed head. The authorized diff is **README.md +7 and DESIGN.md +9, zero deletions**. All 135 runtime files, authored implementation, configuration, tests, generated consumers and frozen V1 remain unchanged.

The immutable [R000D specification](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/21e7a84365fae37a86cae5c7d5e41008c0adc53f/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261008/REMAINING_RLGWOs/R000D.md) and [accepted D01–D10 audit](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/b879573c298f19189d1f2392108b8b9f3b2cda0b/docs/rlgwo-audit/20261008/workers/C/13-assessment.json) govern this result. Current source was reconciled rather than equated byte-for-byte with the older audit: [currentness](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/qualification/currentness.json), [source reconciliation](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/qualification/source-since-accepted-audit.patch), [135-file runtime manifest](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/qualification/runtime-identity.json). Runtime tree SHA256: `5ff3fdf5a13cd3a798addfef972ed9a2c865f87cce531a23847015dcdc8a7d46`.

| Original obligation | Accepted disposition |
| --- | --- |
| D01 | Captured generation/operation/attempt ownership preserved. |
| D02 | Shared 10s weather/manifest body bounds; separate 10s Image bound; approximately 20s combined radar wait under runnable JS. |
| D03 | Independent settlement and absolute monotonic late-result fences preserved. |
| D04 | Exactly-once owned finalization; old cleanup cannot release active B. |
| D05 | Image deadlines/detached handlers/native late load and separate saved-callback controls accepted. |
| D06 | Deadline diagnostics never renew source/receipt/cache eligibility. |
| D07 | Weather 60s/radar 600s eligibility and normal approximately 30s poll opportunities preserved. |
| D08 | A→B supersession preserves successor data, timestamps, storage, failure state and owned slot. |
| D09 | Healthy weather/radar consumption and ordinary failure controls accepted. |
| D10 | Simulation suppression/advancing scheduling and independent elapsed deadlines preserved. |
| D11 / A01 | Three reached semantic mutants fail their intended original assertions; healthy/boundary controls pass. |
| D12 / A02–A03 | All ten native holds recover through normal eligible acquisition; late-owner variants accepted. |
| D13 / A04 | Affected original pixels, opaque half Moon, reduced/full motion accepted within the limits below. |
| D14 / A05 | README+7/DESIGN+9 delivered; exact public bytes verified. |
| D15 / A06 | Independent joined qualification, immutable custody and actual delivery accepted; certificate-first issue effects follow this comment readback. |

All three mutations were reached against extracted actual source: body-deadline removal, owner-finalization guard removal and Image-deadline removal. Each produced exactly one intended semantic failure, with paired healthy controls. The unchanged 9,999/10,000ms and delayed 10,001ms controls remain. [Mutant originals/raw failures/healthy bindings](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/A01/receipt.json). Six regression suites report 245 passes, 0 failures, 4 inherited TODOs: [regression receipt](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/regression/receipt.json).

The ten native cases are weather headers, weather partial JSON body, radar manifest headers, radar manifest partial JSON body and native radar Image, each in Chromium 148.0.7778.96 and Firefox 150.0.2. They retain native fetch/Response.json/Image/canvas, real monotonic deadlines and actual normal-poll recovery. Weather retries occur after real 60s eligibility plus the next poll; radar uses the disclosed post-timeout wall offset. [A02 exact case index](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/native/a02-index.json), [A03 late/ignored-abort and supersession index](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/native/a03-index.json), [immutable raw/gzip receipt locations](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/62c283c61be73fdfe8db32e0b34ebf268aace57c/evidence/R000D/publication/receipt-locations.json).

Affected held/expired/unavailable/recovered 325×530 card pixels at 390×600 DPR1, warm half-Moon opacity, cloud continuity and reduced/full motion are accepted by the independent reviewer. Chromium continuous-motion credit is **only 160.00≤PTS<190.00** in each original night recording, 750 consecutive frames over 30s. Firefox uses the explicitly authorized original-PNG/native-render/canvas route. [A04 originals/index](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/native/a04-index.json), [original interval review](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/qualification/chromium-a03-a04-review.md), [retained current recording counterevidence](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/contrary/current-chromium-video-intervals.json), [retained historical Firefox failures](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/contrary/historical-firefox/retention.json).

Pages run[38673297933](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/actions/runs/38673297933) completed successfully for the actual merge. **All 142 actual HTTP reads matched exact bytes/hashes:**135runtime files, Pages README/DESIGN, a frozen V1 representative and four raw Git documentation reads at the merge/main. [Actual merged/Pages byte receipt](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ff09b78babe0fbb06b708b068dd1eaead6822f5a/evidence/R000D/delivery/merged-pages-readback.json). Both installed engines exercised the real public settings/prayer/weather consumer: MADINAH 20°C → NEW YORK 19°C, generation 0→1, eligible current/track and explicit model/unobserved provenance, with radar amount 0 and lightning false. Public application/assets were unmodified; only declared synthetic provider ingress was supplied. [Chromium public native receipt](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ff09b78babe0fbb06b708b068dd1eaead6822f5a/evidence/R000D/delivery/public/chromium-r1/public-readback.json), [Firefox public native receipt](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ff09b78babe0fbb06b708b068dd1eaead6822f5a/evidence/R000D/delivery/public/firefox-r1/public-readback.json), [required delivery receipt](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ff09b78babe0fbb06b708b068dd1eaead6822f5a/evidence/R000D/required-delivery-receipt.json), [exact-head owner authority](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ff09b78babe0fbb06b708b068dd1eaead6822f5a/evidence/R000D/exact-head-authority.json).

One read-only GPT-6 Astra Max reviewer reconciled the complete original obligations, source identities, native/raw pixels, documentation, actual PR and delivery. The same executor accepted/joined those exact returns: [complete local independent review](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/62c283c61be73fdfe8db32e0b34ebf268aace57c/evidence/R000D/qualification/premerge-local-review.md), [actual exact-head/publication review](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/62c283c61be73fdfe8db32e0b34ebf268aace57c/evidence/R000D/qualification/pr-publication-review.md), [actual delivered consumer review](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ff09b78babe0fbb06b708b068dd1eaead6822f5a/evidence/R000D/delivery/independent-delivery-review.md). Raw evidence is on independent non-deploying commits `ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b`, `62c283c61be73fdfe8db32e0b34ebf268aace57c`, `ff09b78babe0fbb06b708b068dd1eaead6822f5a`, never imported into main. [Raw custody manifest](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/publication/payload-manifest.json), [all 697 object actual public readback](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/62c283c61be73fdfe8db32e0b34ebf268aace57c/evidence/R000D/publication/actual-public-readback.json), [postmerge delivery manifest](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ff09b78babe0fbb06b708b068dd1eaead6822f5a/evidence/R000D/delivery/publication-manifest.json). Gzip is lossless and maps to original receipt hashes; original pending-review labels remain historical observations and are superseded only by the separately bound accepted reviews.

Retained limits and failures:

- Controlled weather/current/hourly input is synthetic model data, not physical observations or live provider-health evidence. Model-estimated conditions remain explicitly unobserved; forecast is not current weather.
- Radar Image/frame/sample recovery is unitless. Radar alpha supplies no quantitative rain amount or lightning authority.
- Radar throttle proof uses a disclosed 600001ms wall-clock offset after the actual monotonic timeout; this is not a real ten-minute watch. Weather waits the real 60s eligibility plus the next normal poll opportunity.
- Native timers/performance are unchanged, but runnable JavaScript can deliver callbacks late. Absolute monotonic eligibility rejects late work after resumption; no suspended-process liveness, physical cancellation or memory-reclamation guarantee is made.
- Chromium continuous-motion acceptance applies only to 160.00<=PTS<190.00 in each original night video, 750 consecutive frames/30s. Whole-run and checkpoint-containing crop/gray intervals remain unqualified; historical Firefox blank recordings remain failures.
- Firefox A04 uses the owner-authorized original-PNG/native-render/canvas route. No continuous Firefox recording is claimed. Cloud hashes or frozen-clock counters are not motion proof.
- Night freshness starts with an already-aged synthetic source and runs at normal 1×. It is not a new real 15-minute receipt/cache-age watch. Reduced stillness is expected; explicit full motion is separately evidenced.
- Four inherited TODOs remain TODO. Six regression suites yield 245 passes/0 failures/4 TODO; the PR-specific R0017 measure job was SKIPPED and is not counted as a new test pass.
- Public A/B screenshots show the existing early Sky preview/refining state. They qualify settings/prayer/weather consumers only and add no final-refined sky/Moon/motion acceptance.
- No runtime/source repair or broad sky-science requalification occurred; frozenV1, authored code, configuration, tests and generated consumers remain unchanged.

- Chromium headers-r1 and Firefox manifest-headers-r1 remain excluded failures. The latter's [Audit-ANDON diagnosis and bounded custody correction](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/ce46f4ce817320fa823e9b863c24ea59e3ca7d9b/evidence/R000D/contrary/teardown-andon.md) preserves its missing-final-receipt status; accepted successors are separately bound. CRLF and preflight404 instrumentation corrections also retain their original failure scope.

The accompanying complete machine-readable `CLOSE-R000D.json` has SHA256 `0aebbe0ec62ee79b8be9efc6e0e361111e265957275a1c194f18058d08964599` and includes all 15 original rows, all 6 acceptance mappings, 18 accepted native receipt/fixture identities and immutable proof URLs. The final completed closure receipt will separately bind this actual posted comment, its independent readback, completed closure event and current delivery. No physical cancellation, perfect timing, live provider health, or completed issue state is inferred from a command result.
